about_the_game:
Ame-chan, the protagonist of Needy Streamer Overload, finally comes to Desktop Mate!

The headline feature is a transformation unlocked when combined with the “OMGkawaiiAngel” DLC. Own both DLC to watch Ame-chan transform into OMGkawaiiAngel, in a transformation sequence recreated to evoke the original game, offering a special experience.

The Desktop Mate version of Ame-chan includes motions that honor her subtle, delicate emotions—such as glancing up while using her phone—capturing her personality down to the smallest details.

Features

  • All-new 3D model created exclusively for Desktop Mate

  • Exclusive motions reflecting nuanced emotional expressions

  • Linked transformation feature with the Needy Streamer Overload OMGkawaiiAngel DLC

Notes

  • Requires Desktop Mate. Please update to the latest version before use.

  • Please use in accordance with the “Guidelines for Video Posting/Streaming and Derivative Works of Needy Streamer Overload.”

  • Under these guidelines, you may stream/post videos on YouTube, Niconico, Twitch, and similar platforms.

Included Content

NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD Ame-chan
